<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Decodes a numeric "leaf" value.</p>


<p>These are integer literals encountered in the type stream. If the value is positive and less than LF_NUMERIC (1 &lt;&lt; 15), it is emitted directly in Data. Otherwise, it has a tag like LF_CHAR that indicates the bitwidth and sign of the numeric data.</p>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Merge one set of id records into another.</p>


<p>This method assumes that all records are id records, and there are no <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/type">Type</a> records present. However, since Id records can refer back to <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/type">Type</a> records, this method assumes that the referenced type records have also been merged into another type stream (for example using the above method), and accepts the mapping from source to dest for that stream so that it can re-write the type record mappings accordingly.</p>
